answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making job access depend on earned vouchers. After each completed job, the buyer issues one non-transferable voucher to the seller, and bigger jobs require a larger voucher balance to bid. A gale of fresh fake identities starts with zero vouchers, so an attacker must first do real work under each fake name before it can touch valuable work. Vouchers expire unless renewed by new completed jobs, so an umber shadow of idle sockpuppets fades instead of accumulating, and the oasis of high-value work stays open only to agents with a record of delivered jobs.
